blocks.value: An array is a fixed-size collection of elements, all of the same type. Its length is set when it's created and can't change afterward. Elements are accessed by index, starting at 0.

dataType[] arrayName = new dataType[arraySize];

int[] num = new int[5]; // 5 int elements: num[0] through num[4]
When an array is created this way, Java automatically fills numeric elements with 0 as a default.
